title: Terminal Shrinkage Averaging Reveals a Schedule-Estimator Interaction in LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2609.25482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) pretraining conventionally returns the raw final iterate. This couples two design choices: the learning-rate schedule that generates the parameter trajectory and the estimator that constructs the deployed model (e.g. the raw final iterate or a checkpoint average). A schedule that promotes optimization progress may differ from one that minimizes variation in the raw final iterate. Separating these choices creates an opportunity to maintain progress late in training while reducing variation in the returned model. To this end, we propose \emph{Terminal Shrinkage Averaging (TSA)}, which interpolates between the raw final iterate and the average of recent checkpoints to balance recent progress against terminal variation. We analyze how TSA changes the preferred terminal learning-rate schedule under a local quadratic approximation and test this interaction through a sequence of controlled NanoChat experiments. Finall

translated_title: 终端收缩平均揭示了大语言模型预训练中学习率调度与估计器的相互作用
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）预训练通常直接返回原始的最终迭代结果。这一惯例将两个设计选择耦合在一起：生成参数轨迹的学习率调度，以及构建最终部署模型的估计器（例如原始最终迭代或检查点平均）。促进优化进展的学习率调度，可能与最小化原始最终迭代波动的调度有所不同。将这两个选择分离，创造了一种机会，即可以在训练后期保持优化进展的同时，降低所返回模型的波动性。为此，我们提出了终端收缩平均（Terminal Shrinkage Averaging, TSA）方法，它在原始最终迭代与近期检查点的平均值之间进行插值，以平衡近期优化进展与终端波动。我们在局部二次近似下分析了TSA如何改变最优的终端学习率调度，并通过一系列受控的NanoChat实验验证了这种相互作用。
tldr: 提出终端收缩平均（TSA）方法，通过在原始最终迭代与近期检查点平均之间插值，将学习率调度与模型估计器这两个设计选择解耦，并揭示了大语言模型预训练中二者之间的相互作用。
en_tdlr: Proposes Terminal Shrinkage Averaging (TSA), which interpolates between the raw final iterate and recent checkpoint averages to decouple the learning-rate schedule from the model estimator, revealing their interaction in LLM pretraining.
